summary: Murder conviction under IPC s.302 r/w s.34; appellant sole convict among four accused; inconsistencies in witness testimony regarding source of light, weapon distribution; absence of Mangti (deceased's wife) and investigating officer as witnesses; motive questioned as vague; arms act charge under Arms Act s.25/27 dismissed; 14+ years imprisonment served; eyewitness credibility challenged vs. testimonies identifying appellant as shooter.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.302 r/w s.34
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence under IPC s.302 r/w s.34 set aside; appellant acquitted as benefit of doubt extended.
